title: The Humourous remark at dinner
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：humourous　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 humourous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the foreman wrote of ① a humourous remark at dinner in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more humourous than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the humourous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most humourous remark at dinner anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too humourous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the humourous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a humourous story about the mayor, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as humourous as the story about the mayor they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was humourous or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something humourous, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite humourous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the humourous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another humourous remark at dinner in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more humourous than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most humourous story about the mayor in the whole site, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the humourous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 幽默（前置定语 a humourous remark at dinner：1987 年工头在施工单里记下的那件幽默的妙语）
B. adj. 幽默／诙谐（比较级 more humourous than：文中两处，一处比饭桌上的妙语，一处比预想）
C. adj. 幽默／诙谐（最高级 the most humourous：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 幽默（表语 too humourous to do：母亲觉得它太幽默，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 诙谐（前置定语 a humourous story about the mayor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩诙谐的故事）
F. adj. 诙谐（同级比较 as humourous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩关于镇长的诙谐故事相比）
G. adj. 诙谐（后置定语 something humourous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 诙谐（受程度副词修饰 quite humourous：那位工人的评价）

items.q: the most humourous remark at dinner anybody
a humourous story about the mayor
The most humourous story about the mayor in

answers.why: humourous 意为“幽默”，1987 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件幽默的妙语”，此处作前置定语 a humourous remark at dinner。
humourous 意为“幽默”，此处用比较级 more humourous than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
humourous 意为“幽默”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最幽默的一件，故用最高级 the most humourous remark at dinner。
humourous 意为“幽默”，母亲认为这件东西“太幽默了，谁也用不上”，too humourous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
humourous 意为“诙谐”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩诙谐的故事”，此处作前置定语 a humourous story about the mayor。
humourous 意为“诙谐”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩关于镇长的诙谐故事一样诙谐”，同级比较用 as humourous as。
humourous 意为“诙谐”，施工单上那半行字要的是“诙谐的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something humourous。
humourous 意为“诙谐”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当诙谐”，quite 修饰原级 humourous。
humourous 意为“诙谐”，1997 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要诙谐”，故用比较级 more humourous than。
humourous 意为“诙谐”，母亲 1999 年说的是“整个工地里最诙谐的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most humourous story about the mayor。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件幽默的妙语。（a humourous remark at dinner）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更幽默。（more humourous than …）
母亲觉得它太幽默，谁也用不上。（too humourous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩诙谐的故事。（a humourous story about the mayor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩关于镇长的诙谐故事一样诙谐。（as humourous as …）
到了 1994 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件诙谐的东西。（something humourous）
answers: In 1987 the foreman wrote of a humourous remark at dinner in the sheet.
Everybody said it was more humourous than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too humourous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a humourous story about the mayor.
He said nobody would call it as humourous as the story about the mayor they had once had.
By 1994 the sheet asked for nothing but something humourous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 humourous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the foreman wrote of a humourous remark at dinner in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most humourous remark at dinner in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too humourous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a humourous story about the mayor, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite humourous, and everybody laughed.
The humourous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
